purpose: Supplementary supported-Sand contact questions; original SOL281 and historical query sets remain unchanged. Canonical retrieval is not physical or platform acceptance.

questions.query: How does detached-tree contact measure exact rotated native-cell overlap without filling compound holes or counting internal proxy seams?
facts: SAT and polygon clipping intersect full native unit squares with one coherent rotated rectangle union; AABBs only bound traversal.
Six proxies and two holes remain; exact exterior source-grid runs remove partial sibling seams.
All nonempty material contributes geometry but only supported ambient Sand supplies the new response.

questions.query: What makes the optional Sand resistance respond to a rotating edge while preserving symmetric contact and bounded energy?
facts: The pure planner uses current contact-point velocity, mass and inertia for a zero-restitution unilateral normal impulse.
Only currently approaching parallel segments enter the length-weighted resultant, recomputed on each of four fixed sweeps.
Each planned impulse must satisfy the registered energy bound; actual Rapier energy is checked separately, with no full multi-contact convergence claim.

questions.query: Can a stale, replayed or wrong-revision detached-body contact observation apply another Rapier impulse?
facts: The worker freezes copied observations before publication; main never queries live native cells.
Snapshot, tick, exact revision, epoch, token, generation and forward sample order are checked before candidate RID mutation.
Sample age over one, corner drift over 0.25 cells, malformed or incomplete geometry and duplicate observations refuse.

questions.query: How do I enable experimental Sand resistance in the structural detachment lab, and does it change Water or promote Y1?
facts: V resets and toggles the candidate; --sand-resistance enables it at launch. Without the flag the prior response remains selected.
The lab observes both arms, while session resistance defaults to false.
The 11/9 interface, conservative material transactions, Water, chemistry, hard-contact and ordinary GCR defaults remain; Y1 #343 is not promoted.

questions.query: Are asynchronous overlap-cell-samples native cell-ticks, and what denominator includes all contact-processing work?
facts: Area-samples and overlap-cell-samples count complete consumed native observations, not native simulation ticks.
Total owner observation/freeze and main response CPU includes refused attempts and unconsumed publications; the proposed mean divides by complete consumed geometry observations.
Repeated live trajectories have ranges but are not matched causal comparisons; headless CPU measurements do not establish GPU or human acceptance.

questions.query: Does improved detached-tree contact now resolve deep embedding or restore a sleeping Rapier aggregate into native terrain?
facts: Deeply embedded cells without an exterior face crossing can retain overlap without a response segment.
The candidate adds no position correction, cell mutation or automatic restoration; sleeping remains aggregate ownership.
Dense-contact, lifecycle, source-qualified platform and human gameplay gates remain separate; #347 stays draft and #281/#12 remain open.
